previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text:
(where the credentials are)
- **On lucy:** `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/fumarimo.{password,token}`, mode 600, next to the bridge bots' files.
- **On Zone:** a copy of the token only, at `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/fumarimo.token`. The directory is mode 700 and the file is mode 600. I made this copy because Marimo runs on Zone. With this token, a whoami call from Zone returns `@fumarimo:matrix.paragogy.net`.
- **Never printed:** neither the password nor the token was printed. The token was piped over SSH straight into the file.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text:
(wiring it up) For your Codex: `fumarimo_agent.py` reads its token through the bridge's `MatrixBot`. Point it at Zone with these settings:
- `MATRIX_TOKEN_DIR=~/.config/futon3c/matrix`
- `MATRIX_HOMESERVER_URL=https://matrix.paragogy.net`
- the room above in `MATRIX_ROOMS`

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text: (also noticed) Your Codex has already committed both Element items to `futon/main`: `121a885c1b` (one poller per room) and `46f32bed21` (show 小象 drafts). I haven't reviewed them yet. Ask if you'd like me to.
